flashcard_questions.q: Where is Rio de Janeiro located within Brazil?
flashcard_questions.a: On the south-east coast, in Guanabara Bay.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the population of Rio de Janeiro?

flashcard_questions.a: A city with more than 10 million people.

flashcard_questions.q: What share of Brazil's GDP does Rio produce?
Which Rio statue is one of the New Seven Wonders of the World?
Which global sporting event did Rio host in 2016?
How many visitors does the Rio Carnival attract each year?
What percentage of Rio's children aged 10 and above are literate?
How do medical staff reach patients in the Santa Marta favela?
flashcard_questions.a: They carry medical kits directly to people's homes.

flashcard_questions.q: What effect has home healthcare had in the Santa Marta favela?
flashcard_questions.a: Infant mortality has fallen and life expectancy has risen.

flashcard_questions.q: What share of Rio's population now has access to mains water?
What share of Rio's electricity will the new hydroelectricity complex provide?

flashcard_questions.a: Work that is not officially registered or regulated, such as street vending.

flashcard_questions.q: What share of new arrivals in Rio work in the informal sector?
What does Rio's 'Schools of Tomorrow' programme teach young people?
flashcard_questions.a: Practical skills that help them find formal employment.

notes: 15 cards: 3 term-to-definition (megacity, informal sector, Rio's location), 8 case-study-to-fact with one figure each (13.6 million, 5% of GDP, 1.7 million carnival visitors, 95% literacy, 90% mains water, 30% hydroelectricity, 60% informal work, 2016 Games), 2 cause-to-consequence (Santa Marta home visits and their effect), 2 place-to-feature (Christ the Redeemer, Schools of Tomorrow). Dropped the port export list because naming three commodities on one card is an enumeration.
